title: PinnacleAI® Regulatory Journey | Purpose, Evidence and Export Readiness
purpose: A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, people, methods, everyday practice and review.
The seven-stage pathway connects capability identification and AbilityScore® measurement with readiness forecasting and a child-specific plan.
Integrated intervention, parent-guided practice, progress review and reassessment work toward growing independence and participation.
PinnacleAI® supports the pathway as licensed non-diagnostic developmental-support software with human and professional review.

questions.question: What is PinnacleAI®?
questions.answer: PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 is identified in the supplied Indian manufacturing licence as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. Its stated functions include developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

questions.question: Who is the legal manufacturer?
questions.answer: Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the licence holder and legal manufacturer named in the reviewed regulatory records. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

questions.question: What does the Free Sale Certificate establish?
questions.answer: FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for the licensed device. It supports country-specific market-access applications; it is not approval or registration in another country.

questions.question: Does PinnacleAI® diagnose children?
questions.answer: No. The licensed product is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Clinical and care decisions remain within the appropriate human and professional review process.

questions.question: Has PinnacleAI® been registered in other countries?
questions.answer: This page does not claim a foreign registration. Each market will be labelled researching, representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review or registered only when the corresponding evidence is available.

questions.question: How can the evidence be reused?
questions.answer: Use the citation downloads and machine-readable JSON or text exports. Cite the exact licence, certificate or dated report for a specific claim and retain its date and scope.
